newsitem.title: UK: UK M0 drops to s/a 25.024 bln stg week to April 23.
newsitem.headline: UK M0 drops to s/a 25.024 bln stg week to April 23.

text.p: British M0 money supply dropped to a seasonally adjusted 25.024 billion stg in the week to April 23 from 25.197 billion the week before, the Bank of England said on Monday.
On an unadjusted basis, M0 fell to 24.684 billion stg from 24.801 billion the previous week.

Notes and coins in circulation were marginally lower on a seasonally adjusted basis at 24.964 billion stg, from 24.981 billion. But unadjusted notes and coins rose to 24.624 billion stg from 24.585 billion.
